svg.title: A code split across six cells
svg.desc: A fresh, matching SMS or supported email supplies the code. The original form receives a paste or individual characters. Entry is checked against the joined cells.
svg.text: Entering a code across six cells
Read a fresh SMS or supported email.
Focus the first cell and paste the code.
If the paste is incomplete, fill each differing cell.
Read the cells together to check the code.
